data.content_ref: inline:The transfer claim in SRC_003 shares mechanism with the causal-DAG requirement in SRC_006: both demand that independence be verified through interventions rather than inferred from non-simultaneity, but the shared mechanism is refuted if interventions on single nodes are shown to be impractical at scale, making the causal-independence test of SRC_005 vacuous while the structural-overturn evidence of SRC_003 remains tractable.
